R = n1*n2*sv / (1 + delta12) * exp(-fuel_depletion*n1*n2*sv) * (1 + bosch_enhance*sv / (screen_scale + sv)) * (1 + maxwell_tail*(sv/(screen_scale + sv))**gamow_power) * (1 + screen_strength*(n1 + n2)/(debye_ref + n1 + n2)) * (1 - brem_loss*(n1 + n2)**2*sqrt(sv) / (brem_ref + (n1 + n2)**2*sqrt(sv)))
